## Maintenance Home

The maintenance landing page. Not a stat-tile wall: one hero number (what needs attention right now), a pipeline rail (where every open job sits in its lifecycle, click-through to filter), and a runway of what's coming due — the same "number that matters, a rail, a runway" shape as the LegalHome redesign (2026-09-03).

Takes the host's already-loaded live collections (assets, work orders, plans, teams, locations) as args — it runs no queries of its own, so it composes cleanly inside a host shell without a second subscription to the same data.
